tagline: Andaman limestone coast — Phuket's high-demand day-trip partner.
summary: Krabi anchors the Andaman's dramatic limestone coast (Railay, Ao Nang, the Phi Phi gateway) and is one of Phuket's highest-demand day-trip partners (~40 nm). It is a core Andaman connected city: crowded speedboats run the Phuket/Phi Phi/Krabi triangle today, and a premium foiling tier removes the pounding that caps repeat ridership.

demand_signals.detail: Heavy Phuket<->Phi Phi<->Krabi day-trip flow on crowded speedboats.
Premium beach-resort segment with strong willingness to pay.
Krabi International adds direct inbound volume to the Andaman cluster.

navier_fit: High as an Andaman connected city to the Phuket flagship; clean Pioneer II legs across the limestone coast with strong resort WTP.
competitive_landscape: Dense, crowded speedboat and ferry fleet across the triangle — rough rides, monsoon cancellations, no premium tier.
seasonality: SW monsoon (May-Oct) brings rough Andaman seas; high season Nov-Apr. Foiling extends the comfortable window.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department and Marine National Park rules (seasonal closures) at established jetties.

precedents.label: Andaman speedboat triangle
precedents.note: Existing high-volume demand a premium foiling tier upgrades.

grab.super_app_fit: In-app Andaman day-trip bundles linking Krabi resorts to Phuket and Phi Phi.
grab.wedge: Premium limestone-coast water tier feeding the Phuket Andaman flagship.
